fields.label: Wallpaper layout
fields.description: Per Screen: each screen gets the wallpaper cropped to it (Ambxst default). Fill: one image covered across the whole desktop, cropped like the desktop was one screen. Fit: one image across the whole desktop, never cropped (empty side bars). Stretch: one image distorted to cover the whole desktop exactly. Center: the wallpaper drawn at its original size, centered on the whole desktop (cropped at the desktop edges when larger).
